verdict.rationale: Relay documents automatic syncing of transactions/expenses into QuickBooks Online and Xero, plus receipt capture/categorization synced automatically, and Plaid connections to other money apps like Expensify — directly matching the finance-lead's story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the accounting sync quality (community evidence covers banking UX/pricing but not the QBO/Xero integration itself), and detail on setup complexity or reconciliation accuracy.
